description: This file contains the implementation of the StubGenerator class, which creates stubbed JAR files from Java class definitions, filtering out private members and generating stub classes for debugging or other purposes.

classes.name: StubGenerator
classes.description: A utility class for generating stubbed JAR files from class definitions, filtering private members, and generating debug source.

methods.name: generateStubbedJar
methods.description: Generates a stubbed JAR file from given class definitions and filter, and writes it to the specified destination.

methods.name: classNameToEntryPath
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified Java class name into a path suitable for JAR entries.

methods.name: createJar
methods.description: Creates a JAR file from the provided class byte arrays and writes it to the output stream.

methods.name: visitClassStubber
methods.description: Visits a class using ASM to generate a stub version based on filtering rules.
